text:
maria: CI shard 12 red on hosted integ run — failing tests that exercise streaming tool-calls with auth. Happens ~50% of runs. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: Build 3102456789 failed: https://ci.redwood/3102456789 — tests/integration/test_toolcall_stream.py::test_stream_auth_toolcall

ben: saw it. grabbing logs now

ben: log shows '400 Bad Request: missing multipart boundary' followed by stream connection reset after ~1.2s. snippet:
```logs
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: text/plain
error: missing boundary in multipart/form-data
...stack...
```

kai: hmm could be our multipart builder in the hosted proxy. Could you rerun with `CI_SHARD=12 RUN_VERBOSE=1`? Also try `pytest -k stream_auth_toolcall -q -s` against staging endpoint: `HOSTED_API_URL=https://staging-infer.redwood`

maria: running local repro now with command: `HOSTED_API_URL=https://staging-infer.redwood pytest tests/integration/test_toolcall_stream.py::test_stream_auth_toolcall -k hosted -q -s` will report back in ~15m

aj: could be ordering of `Content-Type` vs `Authorization` headers after the http-client change last week. cc @ben — can you bisect the range from `a1b2c3d..f9e8d7c`?

ben: starting bisect job now. rough ETA 20m

ben: quick note — when I force single-threaded shard the failures disappear. suspect race in header assembly when concurrency>1

kai: try bumping `MULTIPART_TIMEOUT_MS` in the integ runner to 5000 as a temporary guard. Also check that `requests-toolbelt` didn't upgrade in the env.

maria: added a rerun with `MULTIPART_TIMEOUT_MS=5000` to CI run 3102460001

deploy-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood/3102460001 :white_check_mark: 

ben: bisect found culprit commit f4a9b6e — small refactor in http-client: moved header assembly to worker thread. reverting that change fixes test locally.

maria: nice catch. what's plan? revert or patch?

ben: planning a small revert PR and run full integ. I'll open PR and ping @aj for review.

aj: ack, will review quickly. If tests pass, let's ship revert to unblock.

kai: also going to add a quick unit test around concurrent header assembly to prevent regression.

maria: thanks all. follow-up: add note to release notes about http client concurrency fix. :thumbsup:
